3.Upload Program
==============

     <div class="text-orange">Upload program</div>
     <div class="text-blue">
       Since the program has been uploaded to the Smart Robot Car before the factory, you can just skip this step and no need to upload it repeatedly.<br>

     <div class="text-orange">How to upload the code?</div>
     <div class="text-blue">
       If you have modified the codes of Smart Robot Car, you will need to upload the program again.<br><br>
       <a href="upload_esp32.html" style="color: #0066cc; text-decoration: underline;">Upload the program to ESP32 S3 Camera Module.</a><br>
       <a href="upload_arduino.html" style="color: #0066cc; text-decoration: underline;">Upload the program to the Arduino UNO Board.</a>
     </div>
